notes: A statutory review of how energy decisions are made in Wales could produce recommendations bearing on NRW's advisory, permitting and landholding roles in energy projects; direction is open until terms and findings are published.
summary: The Future Generations Commissioner's Climate and Nature page, updated on 24 August 2026, recorded that in July 2026 the Commissioner announced he would undertake a Section 20 Review into energy policy and decision-making in Wales, using his strongest powers. The same page recorded his call for the Welsh Government to double its ambition for community energy.
title: Future Generations Commissioner announces a Section 20 review of energy policy and decision-making in Wales
